programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Grumblestunk is getting competitive during 'Porthole in Bloom', but so are the local robins! Why are the red-chested birds turning on each other? Tha Greannarlobht a' fàs farpaiseach tron 'Phort Bhàn fo Bhlàth', ach tha 's na brùthan-dearga ionadail! Carson a tha eòin a' bhroillich dhirg a' strì an aghaidh a chèile?

programme.title: Beathaichean a’ Bocadaich
programme.desc: Tha Sophie a’ coimhead tron phrosbaig sheunta aice airson faicinn ciamar a bhios beathaichean a’ bocadaich. Tha i ag ionnsachadh mar a bhios diofar bheathaichean a’ gluasad agus cuide ri a caraidean, tha i a’ cruthachadh dannsa. An-diugh, danns coltach ri losgann agus ochd-chasach! Sophie looks through her magic binoculars to find out how animals boogie. She learns how different creatures dance and, along with her friends, creates a routine using animal movements. Join her and dance like a frog and an octopus!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan a’ cruthachadh còmhlan-ciùil roc le maracas, drumaichean agus sacsafòn! After finding some pasta, the Froglets create a rock band with maracas, drum and saxophone!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha sèithir balg-smùide àraid Granaidh air a mhilleadh nuair a tha a bior-fighe ga tholladh. Tha beachd aig A' Mhàidsear ciamar a cheartaicheas e gnothaichean – ach bu chòir dha èisteachd ri Granaidh! Granny's special puffball chair is punctured by her knitting needle. Major has an idea how to sort things, but he should listen to Granny!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Bidh rudan iongantach a' tachairt ann am prioba na sùla, mar rudan a’ tuiteam às an adhar – rudan a bhios a' cluich ceòl àlainn. Ach dè th’ ann? Unusual things happen in the blink of an eye, like things falling from the sky - things that play sweet music. But what is it?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ leughadh Cùm Rithe Hò Rò. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Sally Anne Garland, agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Màiri NicCumhais. Coinneach Rankin reads Cùm Rithe Hò Rò, written and illustrated by Sally Anne Garland and translated into Gaelic by Mairi MacCuish.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Is caomh le Tòmas a bhith cur seachad ùine le crodh. Tha e mar gu bheil iad dha thuigsinn. Nuair a tha droch là aige san sgoil, thig iad thuige is bruidhnidh e riutha. Tha e airson a bhith na bhuachaille nuair a dh’fhàsas e mòr. Tòmas loves to spend time with cows - they seem to understand him. When he’s had a bad day at school, they come to him and he talks to them. He wants to be a herdsman when he grows up.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair nach eil sgeul air Belle, tha Sebastian draghail oir 's e seo an treas trup an t-seachdain seo – 's tha e 'g ionndrainn an caidreadh maidne aca. Ach dè tha ag adhbharachadh seo? When Belle is nowhere to be seen, Sebastian is anxious as this is the third time this week, and he misses their morning hugs. But what could be causing this?

programme.title: Cuach na Cloinne 2026
programme.desc: Cuairt dheireannach farpais ball-coise 5-a-side a’ gabhail àite ann an Inbhir Nis le sgiobaidhean bho air feadh na dùthcha a’ strì airson Cuach na Cloinne a bhuannachadh. The national final of the 5-a-side football competition takes place in Inverness, with teams from across the country competing to win Cuach na Cloinne.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha a’ chiad teirm a’ tighinn gu crìch aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha e follaiseach a-nise gu bheil comhstrì eadar cuid den luchd-obrach. Tha Ms Sharpe agus cuid de na sgoilearan aice trang ag ullachadh airson a’ Mhòid, agus chan eil cùisean idir rèidh eadar Danny agus Mrs Fullerton. As the first term comes to an end, it’s evident that tensions are building at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche. Miss Sharpe and her pupils are busy preparing for the Mòd and it’s looking as if Danny and Mrs Fullerton are out for revenge.

programme.title: Eilean Mo Ghaoil (From Lewis with Love)
programme.desc: Iain Angus goes lobster fishing in Great Bernera, and the west side football team get back to training.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Megg McCredie from Crieff is Joy’s guest in the studio and Calum Maclean is in a small village on the Isle of Harris, which once attracted worldwide attention.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Port Steòrnabhaigh
programme.desc: Based in the main port in the Hebrides, we follow the beating hearts of Stornoway Harbour. In her shelter, there is a bustling community to be found. In this final episode, we mark a historic day for the Hebrides as the first cruise ship has arrived at the Deep Water Terminal, and tourists get a chance to visit some of the island’s top attractions. Stèidhte ann am prìomh port nan Eilean Siar, the sinne a’ leantainn cridhe Port Steòrnabhaigh. Na fasgadh, tha coimhearsnachd trang ri lorg. Anns a’ phrògram mu dheireadh, tha sinn a’ comharrachadh là eachdraidheil anns na h-eileanan le fàilte air a’ chiad bhàta-crùis aig Cala Domhain Steòrnabhaigh, agus gheibh an luchd-siubhail cothrom a dhol gu feadhainn de phrìomh làraich nan Eilean. Thig còmhla rinn ‘s sinn a’ leanntainn beatha ann am Port Steòrnabhaigh.

programme.title: Patagonia
programme.desc: Keith's journey takes him deep into Argentine Patagonia, where he kayaks to the awe-inspiring Perito Moreno Glacier.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Join Angus Mackay in the Western Isles of Scotland as he prepares for a summer’s fishing off the east coast of Lewis. In this episode, Angus gets his boat out of cold storage, and visits the local fishing emporium to get everything he needs for a summer’s angling. There are lots of checks and painting to be done before the boat is launched on a lovely summer’s morning. Thigibh còmhla ri Aonghas MacAoidh sna h-Eileanan Siar ann an Alba agus e ag ullachadh airson samhradh ag iasgach far costa an ear Leòdhais. Anns a’ chiad phrògram seo, thig an eathar a-mach às an stòras fuar, agus tha Aonghas a’ tadhal air a’ bhùth-iasgaich gus na dh’ fheumas e airson samhradh air sàl a’ cheannach. Às dèidh sin, tha gu leòr ri dhèanamh mus cuir iad an eathar a-mach air madainn samhraidh bhrèagha.

programme.title: Transatlantic Sessions
programme.desc: Sreath ùr. Julie Fowlis le taghadh ciùil bho dà dheichead de Transatlantic Sessions. Julie Fowlis presents highlights from two decades of Transatlantic Sessions.

programme.title: Luchd-Brathaidh Cogaidh | Spies of War
programme.desc: 1962: Tha an saoghal air fad air bhioran agus cogadh niùclasach air fàire ri linn astasan Sobhietach ann an Cùba. Air cùl ghnothaichean, tha neach-brathaidh Sobhietach a’ cuideachadh Kennedy an aghaidh Khruschev. Ionnsaich mar a bhrath Oleg Penkovsky an t-Aonadh Sobhietach – agus mar a chaidh an Treas Cogadh Saoghail a sheachnadh. 1962: The world holds its breath as nuclear war looms during the Cuban Missile Crisis. Behind the scenes, a Soviet spy helps Kennedy face Khrushchev. Discover how Oleg Penkovsky betrayed the USSR - and helped avert World War III. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Fàilte gu Fraochy Bay , baile nach fhaic thu a h-uile là! Is iomadh annas a tha ri fhaicinn sa bhaile , agus sin gun ghuth air cail ach muinntir a bhaile fhèin. Tha cobhair a dhith air dannsairean a bhaile agus 's e Murdo Handel gaisgeach na h uaireach. Welcome to the colourful and unusual world of Fraochy Bay, a miniature metropolis somewhere off the fringes of the map. The local dance troupe are in distress, a situation which calls for careful handling of a musical score.

programme.title: Port
programme.desc: Music documentary in which Julie Fowlis and Muireann NicAmhlaoibh explore shared musical roots in County Cork.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take you so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. A team of insurance professionals face off against a trio of committed gamblers. Who will win the battle as they compete to draw together the connections between things, which, at first glance, seem utterly random - such as Prince of Darkness, Bambi, Grocer and Tarzan?

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: The Revolution, now a war for American independence, faces its toughest challenge yet as General Washington tries to defend New York City from invasion by sea. The resulting Battle of Long Island is a huge defeat for the Americans, who narrowly escape and spend the next several months on the run. In late December, Washington’s army regroups and prepares to attack an outpost in Trenton, New Jersey. A film by Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: As America braces for a third year of devastating war, British commanders launch campaigns to take Albany and Philadelphia. General Howe beats General Washington at Brandywine and Germantown, while the Continental Congress flees Philadelphia. But the Americans’ surprising victory over General Burgoyne at Saratoga opens the door for France to officially support the United States. A film by Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt

programme.title: Universe
programme.desc: A space mission discovers the dramatic history of the Milky Way. Professor Brian Cox reveals how our galaxy endured multiple collisions as rival galaxies fought for survival.

programme.title: The Nazis: A Warning from History
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler loved to watch feature films, and he liked one film in particular, the Hollywood epic The Lives of a Bengal Lancer. 'It was certainly his favourite film,' says Herbert Dohring, a member of Hitler's SS bodyguard, 'and he would always talk about it - this huge English empire - how such a relatively small people could establish and manage something like that.' Hitler would later say, 'What India was for England, the territory of Russia will be for us.' How was it possible then, that in 1939 Hitler found himself at war with a country whose achievements he admired, Great Britain, and allied to his ideological enemy, the Soviet Union? With the help of archive footage and interviews with eyewitnesses, including former diplomats and members of the Nazi party who had never appeared on television before, this film charts the course of Hitler's road to war.

programme.title: One Foot in the Past
programme.desc: Kirsty Wark investigates how stately homes go about opening up their kitchens and servants quarters to visitors. We go behind the scenes at Erdigg, Ham House and Chatsworth.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: Writer Peter Flannery looks back on his experiences creating the acclaimed 1996 drama Our Friends in the North. Following the lives of four friends from Newcastle over a period of three decades, the series struck a chord with the nation’s viewers and turned its young cast into household names. In this introduction to the series, Peter shares the behind-the-scenes story of how the drama was made - an epic tale in its own right - and assesses the impact it had on audiences, the cast and those who helped create what is today considered a landmark piece of television.

programme.title: Our Friends in the North
programme.desc: First episode of a nine-part drama charting 30 years in the lives of four Geordie friends from 1964-1995. While Nicky decides he wants to change the world and Geordie heads for London, Mary and Tosker make a life-changing mistake.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin has a friendly disagreement with a developer about what to do at a Northampton flat. Jacqui is in Norwich, where there’s potential to convert a former shop into a flat. Dion is in Stoke, where new windows are part of a long to-do list.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: Nursery Scandals: What Went Wrong?
programme.desc: Following the death of a toddler at a ‘good’ rated nursery, Hayley Hassall investigates problems in early years care. Does the system designed to protect young children respond quickly enough when problems arise – and what happens when it fails? Focusing on three cases which had devastating consequences, Hayley hears from the parents of young children let down by safeguarding errors - and the whistleblowers who tried to prevent them. Contains upsetting scenes.

programme.title: Nursery Scandals: What Went Wrong?
programme.desc: Following the death of a toddler at a ‘good’ rated nursery, Hayley Hassall investigates problems in early years care. Does the system designed to protect young children respond quickly enough when problems arise – and what happens when it fails? Focusing on three cases which had devastating consequences, Hayley hears from the parents of young children let down by safeguarding errors - and the whistleblowers who tried to prevent them. Contains upsetting scenes.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin has a friendly disagreement with a developer about what to do at a Northampton flat. Jacqui is in Norwich, where there’s potential to convert a former shop into a flat. Dion is in Stoke, where new windows are part of a long to-do list.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin has a friendly disagreement with a developer about what to do at a Northampton flat. Jacqui is in Norwich, where there’s potential to convert a former shop into a flat. Dion is in Stoke, where new windows are part of a long to-do list.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross discovers how nature influenced one Victorian printer to design banknotes for countries around the world. Thomas Forrester shows Charlie a collection of rare and valuable examples, including detailed early designs and specimen notes. It’s all about the money too for the red and blue teams as they battle it out for bargains at an antiques centre near Stratford-upon-Avon. Best friends Sandra and Florence and their expert Tim Weeks go head-to-head with father and son Jason and Andy and expert Izzie Balmer. Will Andy’s love of toy cars outmanoeuvre Sandra’s passion for teapots? Over in Lichfield, what will auctioneer Richard Winterton make of the teams’ lots? And which team will make the most profit and win the day?

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: The latest national and international news from the BBC.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: It's carnival time, one of the biggest celebrations of the summer season in Hamilton. Community Officer PC Chris Douglas is preparing for the island’s annual parade, swapping uniform for a handmade, colourful costume, while his colleagues stay on duty to keep the celebrations running smoothly as thousands line the streets to dance and party. Acting Inspector Tiffany Caisey and Sergeant Mervin Homer move from roadside stops to an unusual call at Dockyard, where a missing phone leads them to a cruise ship packed with 3,000 passengers and the tricky task of locating it on board. In central Hamilton, Sergeant Helen McHugh, K9 handler PC Robin MacNab and her dog Roni head into a park linked to drug activity tracking down a man, who when searched, reveals he’s in possession of a crack pipe and associated drug paraphernalia. Coastguard Corporal Quentin Burgess and Private Matthew Stephens are patrolling the waters, carrying out checks ahead of a busy maritime weekend. In the the run-up to carnival, Officer Chris teams up with PC Krishna Singh and PC Oba Swan to offer crime prevention advice to locals, a reminder of the close community ties that shape island life.

programme.title: Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Cruel scammers force a woman into missing a vital medical appointment under the pretence her internet is being hacked. But it's all lies that have kept the victim tied up with them for over an hour. The ground interceptors battle heavy traffic to try to warn her before the scammer clears out her bank account. Later, the team confront the criminals behind the scam in a showdown that needs to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Richie Anderson is in rural Lincolnshire, helping John and Margaret find a large countryside home, with enough room for six visiting grandchildren, on a budget of £400,000. They explore wonderful properties, including one with a delightful garden, as well as a mystery house close to the coast. Richie also visits a former 300-acre farm now being transformed through an ambitious rewilding project.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Chris Hull and Flo Headlam visit Didcot to transform a garden that has been abandoned to the elements into a Bridgerton-inspired garden with a safe play area for a family's three energetic boys.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Joyce and her husband Mike spent more than 40 years living together in Guernsey. But after they both faced health challenges, they decided to return to Mike’s beloved home county of Yorkshire for a fresh start. Just months after settling in, tragedy struck when Mike passed away unexpectedly, leaving Joyce heartbroken and surrounded by a lifetime of their shared treasures. Now, with the support of close friends Brian and Adele, Joyce is ready to let go of some of the old items that have filled her new home. She hopes the auction will help her gain some space, while raising money to support her son’s work rescuing stray dogs in Thailand, honouring the couple’s shared love of animals. Auctioneer James Broad and restorer Saf Fakir roll up in West Yorkshire to lend a hand. JB uncovers pocket watches, a Victorian cauldron and a trove of jewellery, while Saf takes on three challenging restorations, including an oak coal scuttle, a writing slope and a rare pair of brass coffin stands. With a big mix of lots heading under the hammer, can JB and Saf help Joyce turn Mike’s collections into a lasting legacy and raise enough to help a cause they cared so deeply about?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Scotland play their final Group C match against Brazil in Miami. The match is the fifth World Cup meeting between the two sides and a repeat of the opening fixture of the 1998 tournament, where Scotland were unfortunate to be beaten 2-1 in a close-fought encounter in Paris. Five-time winners Brazil will hunt for a sixth title under the guidance of five-time Champions League-winning manager Carlo Ancelotti, who took over in May last year. Despite a host of attacking talent, the Selecao endured a turbulent qualifying campaign, finishing fifth in the South American group, and haven’t lifted the trophy since 2002.

programme.desc: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Nairn Show to find tips and treats among the food stalls, including how to spot the perfect egg and how to choose the juiciest berries. programme.title: Born to Be Wild
programme.desc: Head of seals, Kaniz, always finds her herself busy throughout the year. During autumn and winter, the centre admits dozens of orphaned and injured grey seals, but once summer arrives, the focus turns to the more delicate and rarer harbour seals which breed in May and June. This year turns out to be a bumper year, and the centre rescues a record number of harbours, all named after herbs and spices, including clove, garlic and five spice. In the large mammal unit, April and Juanita have a single red squirrel orphan to deal with. Named Kite, he is nursed back to full health and then returned to the wild in the beautiful setting of Argaty, a farm specially managed for conservation. April and Juanita even manage to revisit him once he has made himself at home!

programme.title: Mood
programme.desc: Sasha thinks she’s found a best friend in Carly and her life is on the up, partying and having fun, but she still isn’t making enough money online. Carly says Sasha needs to drop the attitude and learn the importance of building a brand. An ecstatic Sasha is booked for an event in an exclusive five-star hotel. Performing a song for the guests, Sasha is the toast of the evening until Carly manipulates Sasha into making a decision she never thought she would. Sasha is left questioning whether this glittering world of status and money is all it seems.

programme.title: Roman Kemp: The Fight for Young Lives
programme.desc: On a daily basis, Roman Kemp is contacted by young people who are struggling. With people turning to him for advice, he’s questioning whether or not there is a worsening mental health crisis and asking if these young people should be offered more support in their own communities. This documentary follows Roman as he immerses himself in schools, youth centres and treatment settings around the country, meets with experts and charities, and visits the Houses of Parliament to try to understand the potential solutions for improving the mental health of young people in the UK today.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Based on an unprecedented discovery in Alberta, Canada, this episode tells the epic tale of a Pachyrhinosaurus herd, one of the largest dinosaur groups that ever lived, through the eyes of its young member Albie.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The tale of one of the largest dinosaurs ever to walk the earth, a colossal, long-necked Lusotitan. Living 150 million years ago on an island known as the Iberian Mesta, now in Portugal, this 25-metre-long titan dwarfs every other dinosaur in the region. Yet its intimidating size is only part of the story. The ultimate goal of the male of the species is to win over a female and secure his legacy. It’s a quest that sees him embark on an epic journey as he risks his life for love.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May buy old British roadsters from Jensen-Healey, Lotus and TVR before taking a wistful journey through the remnants of the UK's sports car industry, starting in Norfolk and ending up at the mothballed TVR factory in Blackpool. Also, Jeremy takes to the test track in the sensational new Ferrari 458 Italia, and laid-back Hollywood legend Jeff Goldblum is the Star in the new Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: I Kissed a Girl
programme.desc: Emotions are still running high after last night's dinner party, and with feelings heating up, Dannii arrives with a chemistry test that really puts the girls' heads in a spin. Teamed with a surprise announcement that the first Kiss-Off is only hours away, it’s crunch time in the masseria for our couples. As two girls go head to head, vying for the same girl's affection, one drops the ‘L’ word and another sheds a tear. But whose summer of love is about to come to an abrupt end?

programme.title: I Kissed a Girl
programme.desc: After an intense Kiss-Off, the masseria waves goodbye to its first girl. But when cracks start to emerge in couples, candid conversations leave some feeling unsettled. An invitation from Cupid to attend a chemistry test under the stars leads the girls to a seductive evening full of temptation. Dannii oversees a spicy night, culminating with one heart-racing surprise.

programme.title: Road House
programme.desc: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton is persuaded to take a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys road house, only to learn that the bar is being terrorised by a gang working for a local crime boss.

programme.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
programme.desc: An investigation into a viral prison sex tape leads journalist Mobeen Azhar to discover an illicit prison economy fuelled by inappropriate relationships, coercion and contraband.

programme.title: Mood
programme.desc: Sasha thinks she’s found a best friend in Carly and her life is on the up, partying and having fun, but she still isn’t making enough money online. Carly says Sasha needs to drop the attitude and learn the importance of building a brand. An ecstatic Sasha is booked for an event in an exclusive five-star hotel. Performing a song for the guests, Sasha is the toast of the evening until Carly manipulates Sasha into making a decision she never thought she would. Sasha is left questioning whether this glittering world of status and money is all it seems.

programme.title: Roman Kemp: The Fight for Young Lives
programme.desc: On a daily basis, Roman Kemp is contacted by young people who are struggling. With people turning to him for advice, he’s questioning whether or not there is a worsening mental health crisis and asking if these young people should be offered more support in their own communities. This documentary follows Roman as he immerses himself in schools, youth centres and treatment settings around the country, meets with experts and charities, and visits the Houses of Parliament to try to understand the potential solutions for improving the mental health of young people in the UK today.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Based on an unprecedented discovery in Alberta, Canada, this episode tells the epic tale of a Pachyrhinosaurus herd, one of the largest dinosaur groups that ever lived, through the eyes of its young member Albie.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Wildlife documentary telling the story of Moja, a five-month-old lion cub living with his single lioness mum, Nyota, in Kenya's Masai Mara. Together, they face a fight for life.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The tale of one of the largest dinosaurs ever to walk the earth, a colossal, long-necked Lusotitan. Living 150 million years ago on an island known as the Iberian Mesta, now in Portugal, this 25-metre-long titan dwarfs every other dinosaur in the region. Yet its intimidating size is only part of the story. The ultimate goal of the male of the species is to win over a female and secure his legacy. It’s a quest that sees him embark on an epic journey as he risks his life for love.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May buy old British roadsters from Jensen-Healey, Lotus and TVR before taking a wistful journey through the remnants of the UK's sports car industry, starting in Norfolk and ending up at the mothballed TVR factory in Blackpool. Also, Jeremy takes to the test track in the sensational new Ferrari 458 Italia, and laid-back Hollywood legend Jeff Goldblum is the Star in the new Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
programme.desc: An investigation into a viral prison sex tape leads journalist Mobeen Azhar to discover an illicit prison economy fuelled by inappropriate relationships, coercion and contraband.

programme.title: Springwatch
programme.desc: As the second week of Springwatch draws to a close, Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan continue to uncover the remarkable wildlife stories unfolding at Crom, the beautiful reserve cared for by the National Trust. A mammal medley takes centre stage, with appearances from the pine marten, red squirrel and badger, whilst many of the chicks being monitored on the live cameras are beginning to fledge. Meanwhile, Iolo Williams wraps up his London adventure in Ealing, where local communities and conservation groups are working hard to restore wildlife and bring nature back into the urban landscape.

programme.title: In Ten Pictures
programme.desc: How did Vladimir Putin emerge from a shadowy existence as a KGB agent in 1980s East Germany to become one of the most powerful men on the planet? This film examines Putin’s rise to power through his enduring relationship with images, and his innate understanding of their power.

programme.title: Emma Barnett: Fighting Endometriosis
programme.desc: Emma Barnett shares her life-long struggle with endometriosis – a disease affecting one in ten women of reproductive age, which causes excruciating, often debilitating, pain. Inside Emma’s body, rogue cells similar to the lining of the womb mysteriously appear on other organs, creating lesions which bleed, scar and cause inflammation. There is no cure. Endometriosis is as common as diabetes but receives a fraction of the research funding. Emma travels across the UK to meet a few of the millions of women who, like her, are suffering. Through candid conversations, they reveal the extent to which endometriosis is devastating the lives of women – affecting fertility, work and loved ones.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Briony May Williams travels to scenic Devon and Cornwall, helping Andrew and Will swap their busy Oxfordshire town life for something with a little more sea air and a lot less stress. With every property offering its own tempting slice of country living and some serious wow factor, choosing won’t be easy. Taking a break from the house hunting, Briony meets a south Devon escapee who bought a crumbling old farmhouse on a whim five years ago and who is still lovingly bringing it back to life today.

programme.title: Policing Paradise
programme.desc: A runaway rider sparks a hunt through narrow backstreets, coastguards remove hazards drifting off Bermuda’s shores, and rookie officers respond to a rush-hour crash.

programme.title: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Off the west coast of Kyushu lies the Amakusa archipelago, formed of around 12 islands. Michael first takes a bullet train to the coast and then a ferry to the islands, where he is greeted by a group of island women performing the colourful, traditional haiya dance originally sung to fishermen. Michael also travels to Sakitsu, a tranquil town where Portuguese missionaries brought Christianity to Japan in the 16th century. After the religion was banned during the Edo period, worshippers hid from the authorities and became known as 'hidden Christians'. Returning to the mainland of Kyushu, Michael takes a regional train up to Kumamoto, where he encounters one of Japan’s most beloved mascots and dives into the story of one of the country's most revered historical figures, Saigo Takamori. Finally, in Shin Omuta, Michael meets Mr Matsunaga, a master swordsmith whose craft hasn’t changed for centuries.

programme.title: Great Central Asian Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his railway tour through Uzbekistan on Tashkent’s suburban electric railway to one of the most spectacular and secretive pieces of Soviet Cold War engineering. Hidden high in the mountains, Michael discovers an installation straight out of a Bond movie - a solar furnace that concentrates the sun’s rays into a beam so hot it cuts through steel. From Tashkent, he picks up the high-speed train west to Samarkand and discovers how China’s Belt and Road Initiative is re-establishing old Silk Road routes with new railway connections. Arriving in the legendary ancient city fulfils a lifelong ambition for Michael. He is overwhelmed by the magnificent architecture of the Registan and moved by traditional music played at its heart. Finally, at one of Central Asia’s most important archaeological sites, Afrosiyob, 7th-century Sogdian wall paintings reveal the diverse and cosmopolitan history of this former Silk Road capital.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: The quiz show where players must avoid Impossible answers to stay in the competition. 21 people start today’s show but how many of them will survive to face the £10,000 question?

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Four more contenders face the black chair under the spotlight and the ticking clock in an attempt to become the next Mastermind champion. Clive Myrie hosts and asks the questions on the contestants' specialist subjects, which are the Empress Matilda, Stevie Nicks, the What Katy Did novels and Universal’s Frankenstein films of the 1930s and 40s.

programme.title: Lightning
programme.desc: Comedian Zoe Lyons presents the electrifyingly fast quiz with a £3,000 jackpot. Six plucky contestants compete across six rounds testing their general knowledge, quick thinking and speedy reactions whilst our ruthless spotlight patrols the studio. The contestants’ motivation in each round is simple: stay out of the light and you’ll be all right!

programme.title: Chris and Meg's Wild Summer
programme.desc: Chris Packham and stepdaughter Megan McCubbin continue their wildlife-watching road trip round Britain, this time exploring the Lake District. Megan surprises Chris with some animals that are renowned for helping to reduce stress – alpacas. They take two, named Ziggy and Danny, for a short walk and a paddle in Derwentwater. Next, they head off in search of the much more elusive red squirrel, as the Lake District is one of their last strongholds in England. They round off their first day by settling in for a pint at the Badger Bar and awaiting the arrival of its main attraction- a live badger cam. The next morning, the pair head South to Foulshaw Moss, a nature reserve for one of Britain’s rarest habitats – raised peat bog. With the help of a local wildlife enthusiast, they find the white-tailed darter, a rare dragonfly that Chris has only seen once before so he’s delighted to spot it. Continuing south to the coast, Chris takes Megs to one of his favourite places, Walney Island, where they catch sight of grey seals, eider ducks and terns. They reflect on why spending time in nature is not only therapeutic but necessary for their wellbeing.

programme.title: Britain and the Sea
programme.desc: David Dimbleby continues his voyage round Britain, sailing his boat Rocket along the south east coast from Hampshire to Kent. This was the front line coast, the edge of Britain essential to its defence and the first point of attack for invasion forces. From the great battleships of Nelson to the sea forts of Henry VIII, this is a story that embraces Britain's darkest and most heroic moments.

programme.title: Wild West - America's Great Frontier
programme.desc: America's high country is the land of grizzly bears and giant trees, of frigid winters and scorching summers, of tough ranchers and gold rush fever. From the Rockies to the Sierra Nevada, survival demands endurance and know-how. From parasitic plants to thieving black bears, tenacious pikas and battling bison, it's in the high country that the west gets really wild.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from the grounds of Chiddingstone Castle in Kent. Antiques experts Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant unearth unique antiques and collectibles that tell fascinating stories of the past. Paul Martin visits a hop garden and hears about the thousands of Londoners who descended on the farms to pick the hops, a way of life that is now lost but not forgotten.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Harry Aikines-Aryeetey, Ania Magliano, Joe Swash and Jasmine Takhar take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games retro bag?

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: In Zurich, Michael Portillo has a brush with the absurd in the anarchic paintings and artistic haunts of the Dadaists, a group of artists who found refuge in the city during the First World War. He visits the impressive Grossmunster Church to find out about the rebellious pastor at the centre of the Swiss Reformation and studies the 500-year-old Froschauer Bible, the earliest German-language bible in the world. A new way of making chocolate is taking hold in the home of confectionery. Michael learns what it takes to be part of the Swiss Bean to Bar movement.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: After being brutally double-crossed by fellow Traitor Harry Clark, Paul Gorton is taking a second swipe at his rival - this time on the hunt to get one up in the world of antiques. The pair are reunited in the Scottish Highlands, vying to be the winner at auction. Aiding and abetting their efforts in Scotland are antiques experts Natasha Raskin Sharp and Roo Irvine, and they hit the road in a Morgan 4/4. In the shops, Harry stumbles on a very apt mug, while Paul resorts to unusual tactics in a bid to bump up his profits. But will it pay off?

programme.title: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby
programme.desc: Rob Rinder and Monica Galetti visit the Intercontinental Shanghai Wonderland, known as the world’s first 'earthscraper' hotel. Learning about the innovative architectural challenges that come with building a hotel into the side of a quarry, the team also help prepare dinner for the hotel’s 3,000 aquarium fish, test drones for the dazzling evening light show, serve guests at a private dinner and even help prepare for a young girl’s fourth birthday party.

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Join Sandi Toksvig on a trip to the seaside with Ed Gamble, Lou Sanders, Sindhu Vee and Alan Davies.

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: The magnificent Zoe Lyons introduces comedians Ria Lina and Tom Ward to the stage.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage as Morocco play Haiti in their final Group C match at Atlanta Stadium. Morocco had won just two of their 16 World Cup games prior to becoming the first African nation to reach a World Cup semi-final in 2022, losing 2-0 to France in Qatar. This is the first time they’ve qualified for three World Cups in a row. In their only previous World Cup appearance, in 1974, Haiti lost all three group games and conceded 14 goals. The 52-year gap between Haiti’s first and second appearance at the World Cup is the fourth longest in the tournament’s history. Group C also contains Scotland, who are facing Brazil at the same time as this game.

programme.title: Chris and Meg's Wild Summer
programme.desc: Chris Packham and stepdaughter Megan McCubbin continue their wildlife-watching road trip round Britain, this time exploring the Lake District. They reflect on why spending time in nature is not only therapeutic but necessary for their wellbeing.

programme.title: Britain and the Sea
programme.desc: David Dimbleby continues his voyage round Britain, sailing his boat Rocket along the south east coast from Hampshire to Kent.
